name: ai-customer-service-monorepo
description: AI customer service desktop application and local/cloud services

scripts.dev:api: cross-env DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./services/business-api/data/business-api.db KNOWLEDGE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8010 python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/business-api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001
scripts.dev:kb: cross-env KB_DATABASE_PATH=./data/knowledge-base.db python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/knowledge-base --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010
scripts.dev:ai: cross-env KNOWLEDGE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8010 python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/ai-reply --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8020
